what.a: An AI assistant for your business. It answers your customers, shows your products or services, and takes orders, bookings and payments 24/7 — through a link, a QR code or your website.

who.a: Any business that serves customers: restaurants and cafés, shops, salons and spas, gyms, clinics, hotels, events and service businesses. We do not support businesses selling alcohol products, tobacco, or any products or services prohibited by local or international laws — see our Terms of Service.

restaurants.a: Yes. It shows your menu with photos and prices, answers questions about your dishes, and takes orders for pickup, delivery or at the table.

shops.a: Yes. It presents your products, answers customers’ questions about them, and takes orders right in the conversation.

salons.a: Yes. It shows your services and prices and lets clients book a date and time. Bookings can be confirmed automatically or by you.

order.a: Yes. Customers add items to their cart in the chat and place their order. You’re notified instantly in your dashboard, with a sound alert.

book.a: Yes. They choose a service, a date and a time. You decide whether bookings are confirmed automatically or approved by you.

pay.a: Yes, with the payment methods you enable: online payment through your own Moyasar, Tap, HyperPay (including mada), MyFatoorah, Stripe or PayPal account (PayPal only in the currencies it accepts), cash on delivery, or paying at the table.

qr.q: Can I use a QR code?
qr.a: Yes. Your business gets QR codes that open your AI Agent — print them for tables, counters, windows or flyers.

website.q: Can I add it to my website?
website.a: Yes. Add the website widget with a short code snippet, or simply link to your Agent page.

languages.a: Yes. Your AI Agent speaks English, Arabic and French, and customers can switch at any time. Your product and service names are translated automatically.

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: Choose a plan and create your account — your {days}-day free trial starts right away, with no credit card required.

afterTrial.a: To keep your AI Agent serving customers, subscribe to your plan from the Billing page in your dashboard. You’re never charged automatically at the end of the trial.

changePlan.a: Yes, from the Billing page. An upgrade applies right away: the price difference for the rest of your billing period is charged pro rata, and the upgrade takes effect once that payment succeeds. A downgrade takes effect from your next billing cycle, with no refund for the current one.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of {product}, a product of {company} ({country}) — our website, dashboard, AI Agent and related services (the “Service”). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.

s1.title: The Service
s1.body:
{product} gives your business an AI Agent that answers your customers, presents your products or services, and takes orders, bookings and payments, together with a dashboard to manage them.
The AI Agent generates answers automatically. Although we work to keep them accurate, they may occasionally be incomplete or wrong: you remain responsible for the information about your business and for reviewing your orders and bookings.

s2.title: Your account
s2.body: You must be at least 18 and authorised to act for your business. Keep your sign-in details secure: you are responsible for everything done with your account. Please give accurate information and keep it up to date.

s3.title: Free trial
s3.body: Each plan starts with a free trial of the length shown on the pricing page. No payment details are needed for the trial and nothing is charged during it. To keep using the Service after the trial, subscribe to a plan from the Billing page. We may limit free trials to one per business.

s4.title: Subscriptions and payments
s4.body:
Plans are billed in advance, monthly or annually, at the prices shown on the pricing page. Our order process is conducted by our online reseller Paddle.com, which is the Merchant of Record for all our orders and handles payments, taxes, invoices and billing enquiries.
Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period until you cancel.

s5.title: Upgrades and downgrades
s5.body:
Upgrades take effect immediately. When you move to a higher plan (or from a monthly plan to the annual plan of the same tier), the price difference for the rest of the current billing period is calculated pro rata and charged right away to your registered payment method, or to another payment method you choose. The upgrade takes effect only once that payment is successful; if the payment fails, your plan does not change.
Downgrades take effect from your next billing cycle. When you move to a lower plan (or from an annual plan to a monthly plan), you keep your current plan until the end of the billing period you have already paid for, whether monthly or annual. No refund or credit is issued for the rest of that period, and your next billing cycle starts, and is billed, on the new plan. You can withdraw a scheduled downgrade from the Billing page before it takes effect.

s6.title: Cancellation
s6.body: You can cancel at any time from the Billing page. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you’ve paid for, and nothing more is charged. No refund is issued for the rest of that period — see our Refund Policy.

s7.title: Usage and fair use
s7.body: Each plan includes a number of customer conversations per billing period, shown on the pricing page. To keep the Service reliable for everyone, AI usage is subject to fair-use limits; we’ll let you know if you approach them.

s8.title: Your content and your customers
s8.body: You keep ownership of the content you add — menus, products, prices, photos and texts — and you allow us to host, process and display it to provide the Service. You are responsible for its accuracy and lawfulness, for fulfilling your orders and bookings, and for your own terms and refunds toward your customers.

s9.title: Prohibited businesses, products and services
s9.body:
{product} and {company} do not support businesses that sell alcohol products, tobacco products, or any products or services prohibited by local or international laws. You may not use the Service — including the AI Agent, catalog, orders, bookings and payments — to offer, promote or sell them.
{product} and {company} have full rights to suspend and block any subscription account that breaks this rule, and to remove the related content.

s10.title: Acceptable use
s10.body: Don’t use the Service for anything illegal, harmful or misleading; don’t try to access other businesses’ data, disrupt the Service, or copy or reverse-engineer it.

s11.title: Availability and changes
s11.body: We work to keep the Service available and secure, but we can’t guarantee it will be uninterrupted. We may improve or change features over time, and we’ll tell you about material changes to these Terms before they apply.

s12.title: Liability
s12.body: To the extent permitted by law, the Service is provided “as is”, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses. Our total liability is limited to the amounts you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.

s13.title: Suspension and closing
s13.body: You can close your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaches these Terms — immediately in the case of the prohibited businesses, products and services described above, and after notice where possible in other cases. No refund is issued for a suspended or blocked account.

s14.title: Governing law

s15.title: Contact

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: This policy explains how refunds work for subscriptions to {product}, provided by {company}.

s1.title: Try it free for 7 days
s1.body: Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial, so you can fully try {product} before paying anything. Nothing is charged during the trial.

s2.title: No refunds on paid subscriptions
s2.body:
Because we offer a 7-day free trial, and because a paid (upgraded) account has already used and consumed AI services, we do not offer refunds on subscription payments — first payments, renewals and upgrades alike.
The only exception is a critical issue caused by {product} itself. In that case, you can request a refund as described below.

s3.title: Renewals and cancellation
s3.body: Subscriptions renew automatically. You can cancel at any time before your renewal date from the Billing page to avoid the next charge; your plan stays active until the end of the period already paid. No refund is issued for the rest of that period.

s4.title: Downgrades
s4.body: A downgrade takes effect from your next billing cycle, monthly or annual. You keep your current plan until the end of the current billing period, no refund or credit is issued for the rest of that period, and your next billing cycle starts on the new plan.

s5.title: Upgrades
s5.body: An upgrade takes effect immediately. The price difference for the rest of the current billing period is calculated pro rata and charged right away to your registered payment method, or to another payment method you choose. The upgrade takes effect only once that payment is successful.

s6.title: How to request a refund
s6.body: Send your refund request to our support email, {supportEmail}, from your account’s email address, with your business name and a description of the issue. You will receive an answer within 48 hours. Approved refunds are processed by Paddle, our Merchant of Record, to your original payment method.

s7.title: Suspended or blocked accounts
s7.body: Accounts suspended or blocked for breaking our Terms of Service — including businesses selling alcohol, tobacco or other products or services prohibited by local or international laws — are not refunded.

s8.title: Your customers’ payments
s8.body: Orders and payments between your business and your own customers are your responsibility; this policy only covers your {product} subscription.

privacy.metaDescription: What personal data SmartManager AI Agent collects, why, and your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: {company} operates {product}. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we use it, who we share it with, and your rights.

s1.title: Who is responsible
s1.body: {company}, {country}, is responsible for the personal data described here. You can reach us at {contactEmail}.

s2.title: What we collect
s2.body: Account details (your name, email and phone; your password is stored securely by our authentication provider). Business information and the content you add. Conversations, orders and bookings handled by your AI Agent. Technical data such as logs, device and browser information. Payment details are handled by Paddle — we never see or store your card number.

s3.title: How we use it
s3.body: To provide and improve the Service, run your AI Agent, process orders and bookings, send service emails (such as subscription updates), keep accounts secure and prevent abuse, and meet legal obligations.

s4.title: AI processing
s4.body: Customer messages are processed by AI service providers to generate your Agent’s answers, under agreements that protect the data. We do not sell personal data.

s5.title: Your customers’ data
s5.body: For the data your AI Agent collects from your customers, your business is the controller and we process it on your behalf, only to provide the Service.

s6.title: Who we share it with
s6.body: Only with the providers that run the Service — database and hosting, payments (Paddle), email delivery, and AI, voice and translation services — and with authorities where the law requires it.

s7.title: How long we keep it
s7.body: As long as your account is active. After it closes, we delete or anonymise your data within a reasonable time, unless the law requires us to keep it longer.

s8.title: Security
s8.body: Data is encrypted in transit, access is restricted, and each business’s data is kept separate from every other business’s.

s9.title: Your rights
s9.body: You can ask to access, correct, export or delete your personal data, or object to its use. Write to {supportEmail}.

s10.title: Cookies
s10.body: We use only the cookies needed to run the website and dashboard: keeping you signed in and remembering your language and currency. No advertising cookies.

s11.title: Changes
s11.body: We may update this policy; we’ll tell you about material changes before they apply.
